thread.title: Dow falls 350 points as trade war fears escalate

author: Pumpkinajn
title: Dow falls 350 points as trade war fears escalate
text: in General Stocks are off to another rocky start on Wall Street.Trade war fears drove the Dow down 350 points in early trading on Tuesday. That put it in negative territory for the year and on track for its sixth straight decline. President - Donald - Trump - Monday - Tariffs President Donald Trump threatened Monday evening to impose tariffs on an additional $200 billion worth of Chinese goods if Beijing follows throw with its promise to retaliate against a previous round of US tariffs."Further action must be taken to encourage China to change its unfair practices, open its market to United States goods, and accept a more balanced trade relationship with the United States," Trump said in a statement. Companies - Lot - Business - China - Losers Companies that do a lot of business in China were among the biggest losers on the Dow on Tuesday.
